timeline.title: BSc Electrical and Electronic Engineering
timeline.detail: Second Class Upper Division, GPA 3.55 of 4.00. Final-year project: autonomous exploration and mapping for a reconnaissance robot, using a laser range finder fused with stereo cameras. Best Undergraduate Project (IESL) and Best Technical Paper (IET Sri Lanka), 2017.

timeline.title: Corporate Applications Engineer
timeline.detail: Chip verification support, including on-site work at Samsung Electronics in South Korea within the first year.

timeline.title: MSc Robotics Engineering
timeline.detail: Distinction. Thesis on a heterogeneous swarm robot system with distributed data processing at the edge for collective transportation.

timeline.title: Robotics Engineer, STEM and IoT
timeline.detail: Robotics and IoT prototypes for Dubai school programmes.

timeline.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer and Project Lead
timeline.detail: Founding robotics engineer, promoted within 10 months to lead a team of 3. Built the core ROS navigation stack. Led deployment of more than 30 humanoid robots across Expo 2020 Dubai, healthcare, and reception sites. Fine-tuned and shipped a YOLOv5 thermal face detector running live in a commercial product.
timeline.mediaIntro: I designed the SLAM and navigation, and deployed the fleet on site. Two clips from a client event:

timeline.title: PhD candidate, robotics and computer vision
timeline.detail: Autonomous real-time UAV mapping with spatial perception for indoor applications. Supervised by George Vosselman and Francesco Nex. Thesis: Structuring the Seen, Exploring the Unseen. Expected completion August 2026.

timeline.title: Mono-Hydra published
timeline.detail: First real-time 3D scene graph from a monocular camera and an IMU. 0.19 m mean error on the ITC 2nd floor at 15 fps.

timeline.title: M2H published
timeline.detail: Four dense tasks in one model. ITC mean error drops to 0.11 m and the loop doubles to 30 fps.

timeline.title: M2H-MX accepted
timeline.detail: 65.60 mIoU on NYUDv2, and ScanNet average ATE down from 17.59 cm to 6.91 cm inside the mapping loop.

timeline.title: Running on the drone
timeline.detail: M2H-MX-L exported to ONNX and TensorRT FP16 with CUDA Graphs, 25.53 fps and 39.02 ms mean GPU compute at 256x192 on a Jetson Orin NX 16GB. Perception, odometry, mapping, and scene graph construction all run onboard.

timeline.title: Mono-Hydra++ under review
timeline.org: ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
timeline.detail: The full system. 0.08 m on the ITC 2nd floor, 0.033 m calibrated ATE on 7-Scenes.

timeline.title: Learned exploration, in progress
timeline.detail: A learned selector over certified routes. Formulation written, experiments not yet run, no results.

teaching.detail: Designed lab exercises on YOLO-based human detection and tracking, and on LiDAR-based SLAM, for the Robotics master's courses. Supervised 3 master's thesis students.
